groups.description: Per side and active slot: the Pokemon in play there, its volatiles and the slot's conditions.

Per side and roster entry (Team Preview order; the engine holds the brought four after it, each at the entry of its set): the Pokemon's engine state. Another seat reads an entry only where it has seen it, so an unseen brought entry and a non-brought one pack alike.
Per seat, side and active slot: what that seat was shown or derives (not in toJSON).
Per seat: its own request and what it derives of the field.
Per seat, side and roster entry: the reveal masks and the history the seat derives from its own channel.
Per seat and side: what the seat derives of the side's conditions.
Per side: side conditions and faint counters.

fields.description: Move actions since the switch-in. The world facts' count differs from the engine's on some turns, so another seat reads its own count (seat_active.move_actions).
Turns since the switch-in (the world facts' active_turns).
Whether it was dragged in this turn.
Its last move (Encore, Disable). Another seat reads its recent history.
The location its last move aimed at.
Its last move used, called moves included.
Whether a move may be disabled by a hidden cause (the own request).
Whether it may be locked into a move (the own request).
Whether it may be trapped by a hidden cause (the own request).
The move it used this turn.
Whether it switched in this turn.
The roster index of the Pokemon in each active slot, -1 empty. Another seat reads seat_active.shown_roster_index (an Illusion user is shown as another entry).
Turns until a slot condition resolves. Never projected.
Whether each slot condition (Wish, a delayed move) is pending at the slot. Another seat reads its history facts' pending effects.
Whether it must switch out (the own forced-switch request).
Whether it is trapped (the own request).
A volatile's counter (the stall counter). Never projected.
Turns left of a timed volatile; some are engine draws. Never projected.
A volatile's hit points (a Substitute). Never projected.
The layers of a stacking volatile (Stockpile). Another seat reads seat_active.volatile_derived.
Whether each volatile is up (locks, choice lock, stall and every other engine condition).
Whether the battle has ended.
The last move used by anyone (Copycat's reference). No seat's view is checked against it, so a seat reads its own history facts' field_last_move instead.
The engine's random-number state as opaque 32-bit words. Never projected.
The engine's Quick Claw roll of the turn. Never projected.
The turn counter.
Turns left of a field condition. Never projected.
Whether each field condition (Trick Room, Gravity) is up.
The terrain.
Turns left of the terrain. Never projected.
The weather.
Turns left of the weather; it depends on the source's item. Never projected.
The current ability (after a Mega Evolution, the forme's). A Mega Evolution or a swap changes it with no line naming the new one, so another seat reads seat_roster.shown_ability.
A type added by a move.
Whether the Pokemon ate a berry. Another seat reads seat_roster.ate_berry.
Whether the Pokemon in each side and active slot hit it this turn.
The set's ability (before an Evolution or a change). No seat derivation tells it apart from a swapped-in ability shown later, so no other seat reads it.
The set's move in each slot while Transform replaces the slots (the copied moves a seat sees are not these).
The engine's base species: a permanent forme change (Mega Evolution, a busted Disguise) moves it, so it is not the preview species another seat holds (seat_roster.preview_species).
The stat stages (the shown boost lines).
Whether it can still Mega Evolve (the own request's canMegaEvo).
Whether it has fainted.
Gender: 0 none, 1 M, 2 F, 3 N.
Current hit points. Another seat reads seat_roster.hp_shown: a benched Pokemon's hit points can change with no display the seat sees, so no projection of this field is its view.
Whether it was hurt this turn.
The Pokemon its Illusion shows: 0 none, else 1 + that roster index.
Whether it is in play.

The held item (a Mega Stone holder's stone is its item). An item can change with no line another seat reads as its own, so no projection of the current item is that seat's view: it reads seat_roster.shown_item.
Whether the item was knocked off. Another seat reads seat_roster.item_lost.
The item last used up. Another seat reads its history facts' last item.
The level the details show (the rule table's adjusted level).
Maximum hit points (level 50 and Stat Points enter here).

Whether the current forme is a Mega Evolution (the engine data's isMega of the forme; a Pokemon transformed into a Mega forme reads 1, which no seat is shown). Another seat reads seat_roster.mega_shown.
The move in each slot. Another seat reads seat_roster.revealed_moves (in reveal order: the slot order is not shown).
Whether each slot is disabled (the own request shows it).
Last turn's move result: 0 none, 1 failed, 2 succeeded.
Maximum PP of each slot.
PP left in each slot.
This turn's move result: 0 none, 1 failed, 2 succeeded.
Whether each slot was used since the switch-in.
The Pokemon's index in the side's current order (the bench order).
How often it switched in.
Whether the details say shiny (another seat: only for an entry it has seen, by the roster gate).
The current species forme (a Mega forme after the Evolution).
The five stored stats other than HP (nature, level and Stat Points enter here).
Whether a stat fell this turn.
Whether a stat rose this turn.
The major status (the engine marks a fainted Pokemon fnt, which is roster.fainted and reads as none here). Another seat reads seat_roster.status_shown.
The sleep counter, an engine draw. Never projected.
The bad-poison stage; it rises silently when the damage is prevented (Magic Guard), so no seat but the owner reads it.
The sleep length the engine drew. Never projected.
Hits taken (Rage Fist). Another seat reads its history facts.
Whether it is transformed (the -transform line).
Truant's loafing turn.
Its current types, one flag per type (the typeless marker ??? sets none). Another seat reads the typechange types it was shown.
Whether it used its item this turn.
Whether the Pokemon in each side and slot hit it this turn: 0 no, 1 unknown, 2 yes.
Whether the seat saw it hurt this turn.
Whether its last move failed: 0 no, 1 unknown, 2 yes.
Move actions since the switch-in, as the seat counts them.
The roster entry the seat was shown in each active slot, -1 empty (an Illusion user is its disguise's entry until |replace|).
Turns until each pending slot condition resolves, as the seat counts them.
The stall counter the seat derives from the shown stalling uses (0 none).
Whether the seat saw a stat fall this turn.
Whether the seat saw a stat rise this turn.
Hits it took, as the seat counts them.
The derived suffix the seat was shown (stockpile2, perish3; a stat for Protosynthesis), as a number or a stat index.

Mask: the seat was shown each volatile (a line started it and none ended it). An id the world writers' slot_conditions or illusion_transform rows name sets no bit: a delayed move's -start (Future Sight, Doom Desire) is a slot condition, and Transform's is roster.transformed.
The turn each volatile began as the seat saw it, -1 none.
Whether the seat's history facts are available (no tracker refused a line).
The last move the seat saw used (its history facts).
Turns since each field condition began, -1 none.
The seat's own request: 0 none, 1 preview, 2 move, 3 forced switch.
Whether the seat saw the battle start (the |start| line).
Turns since the terrain began, -1 none.
Turns since the weather began, -1 none (the reducer's elapsed.weather).
Whether the seat saw it eat a berry.
What the seat knows of whether it was brought: 0 unknown, 1 not brought, 2 brought.
Whether the seat can settle the Pokemon's own facts (its entry in the history facts' roster map): 0 no entry, 1 unknown (the entry's facts are null), 2 known.
Whether the seat can settle the facts of the Pokemon's position: 0 not in play, 1 unknown, 2 known.
The hit points the seat was last shown, -1 never: exact for its own Pokemon, the display percentage for another's. A benched Pokemon's value is the last display.
Whether the seat knows the held item (own: its request; another's: a line showed it).
Whether the seat saw the item used up or removed.
The item the seat saw it use up last.
Whether the seat saw it Mega Evolve.
The stone the seat saw it Mega Evolve with.
Mask: the seat was shown the nickname.
An extra entry the seat's channel forced (Illusion).
The gender the seat was shown: 0 none, 1 M, 2 F, 3 N.
The level the seat was shown (preview or details).
The species the seat was shown at Team Preview for the entry.
Damage dealt last turn in the target's units as the seat sees them.
Damage dealt this turn in the target's units as the seat sees them.
Damage taken last turn in the units the seat sees.
Damage taken this turn in the units the seat sees.
Its place among that turn's actions.
The turn of its latest action, -1 none.
The last move the seat saw it choose.
The turn of that move, -1 none.
Its last target as shown: 0 none, else 1 + side * 3 + slot letter.
Consecutive turns of successful stalling uses.
The moves the seat saw it choose, in reveal order (the owner: its request's slots).
Gate: the seat has seen the entry in play (it showed hit points). Another seat's view of an unseen entry, brought or not, is the unknown entry.
The ability the seat was last shown (none once a swap leaves it unknown).
The item the seat was last shown it holding.
The species forme the seat was shown at this entry (a disguise until it breaks).
Mask: the seat was shown the entry's species forme.
The major status the seat was last shown.
A temporary forme the seat was shown.
The types a typechange line showed, one flag per type.
Whether a typechange line set the types (exact_volatiles' types_known).
Whether that line made it typeless (???, exact_volatiles' types_typeless).
Turns since each side condition began, -1 none.
The team size the seat was shown (|teamsize|).
Turns left of a timed side condition; it can depend on the source's item. Never projected (the seat's elapsed turns are its view).
The layers of a stacking side condition (0 for one that does not stack).
Whether each side condition is up.
The Pokemon that fainted last turn: 0 none, else 1 + its roster index.
The Pokemon that fainted this turn: 0 none, else 1 + its roster index.
Pokemon of the side not fainted.
Pokemon the engine holds for the side: six at Team Preview, the brought four after it.
Pokemon of the side that have fainted (every faint is a line).

out_of_scope.reason: Probe rows per candidate (probe-damage, probe-outcome): computed by the mechanics probe from assumed sets, not battle state.
The candidate's target token: an index of the candidate's own choice into the tokens, not battle state.
The belief's opponent sheet block: a function of the opponent model and the seat's view, not battle state.

world_items.reason: Terastallization, Z-Moves, Dynamax and Ultra Burst are not mechanics of the format: the spec holds none of their state, and their engine keys are omitted as not_in_format.
